cohort: The study included 201 pregnant women with placenta previa or low-lying placenta after 28 weeks gestation who delivered at Peking Union Medical College Hospital between May 2018 and May 2023.
finding: Placenta accreta spectrum (increta or percreta placenta) was identified as the key independent risk factor for severe postpartum hemorrhage in women with placenta previa or low-lying placenta.
mod_finding: The number of previous cesarean sections, in combination with anterior placenta, contributed to the prediction performance for severe postpartum hemorrhage.
